summary.text: War of the Spark takes place on Ravnica, where Nicol Bolas uses the Immortal Sun to trap planeswalkers on the plane and has his Dreadhorde of Eternals harvest their sparks through the Elderspell.

The Gatewatch, joined by Kaya, Ral Zarek and others, rally the guilds against him, and Nissa leads a ritual that resurrects Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact while Chandra and her allies shut off the Immortal Sun.
Liliana turns the Eternals against Bolas, Gideon sacrifices himself to save her, and Niv-Mizzet impales Bolas as Bontu harvests all his stolen sparks.
